The '''SW-7 ion cannon''' was a type of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] produced by [[ArMek/Legends|ArMek]] and used onboard [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruisers]].<ref name="EGWT" />
